ios.desc:
Create and edit checklists and most importantly tick off completed items. It is great for reusable and easily editable checklists to make sure you don't forget anything. Lists that you want again and again are the real focus.

This is the non-syncing version of the app. Fast List Sync which uses iCloud is also available in the App Store. There is a comparison of the two below.

Ideal for shopping, packing or keeping track of just about anything. Particularly useful for keeping track of what you need to do.

Version 1 had great reviews (4.5* average across all stores). See the website to see reviews from all countries app stores: http://human-friendly.com/software. Version 2 is even better so please try it and review.

No advertising, sign in or registration required and none of your information is stored online, everything is in your device all the time even when you are offline. Your privacy is respected at all times, no data is sent to the developer. Crash reports collected via Apple if you have opted in to share these with developers, nothing is directly collected from the app..

Lists can include nested sublists to help you organise the list. And the list can be reordered by clicking the Edit button and dragging the item you want to move.

Quick buttons to hide the completed items and to view all items as a flat list (especially useful in combination to quickly see the last remaining items).

Sublists indicate the number of completed and the total number of items within them. They can also be reordered in the edit mode.

Current Features
- iPhone/iPad/iPod Touch compatible (iOS7 or iOS8 required for Fast Lists 2.0 and later)
- Quick inline item creation and editing - just set name press return
- Copy lists
- Clear ticks - ready for reuse
- Dynamic text support - adapts to system font size set in the main system Settings
- Email lists
* Send and receive lists
* Send to friends and family or to copy between devices.
* Use emailed files for backups.
* Send lists in email bodies to people who don't have this application (in-app purchase).
* Send lists to yourself for printing.
- Nested/sub lists
- Tick and untick items
- Hide ticked items
- Flatten list to see all sublist items
- Manual reorder lists
- iPhone 5 fullscreen support
- iOS 7 support including 64bit build for iPhone 5S, iPad Air and iPad Retina Mini
- 100 items limit on free version, purchases of additional items apply to all devices on the same account
* Unlimited items for small one off purch

quotes.text:
If someone wants an existing but offline only checklists app you can try mine: Fast Lists [0]. It includes options for nesting and hiding the already ticked items so it can be used with large lists.

I haven't added synchronisation yet as I'm not sure the return would be worth the time and I'm also concerned about conflict resolution and data loss.

The OP has a picture of a cockpit which would imply a safety critical environment. I would think long and hard before selling my app in that way especially for an online service.
